title: Feature Removed - Customer Workflow Broken Without Notice
scenario_context: Feature removed/deprecated; workflow broken. Acknowledge impact, offer workaround/alternatives, escalate to product/migrations, avoid promising reinstatement, set cadence.
success_summary: Product change handled with empathy, immediate workaround, and migration support escalation with clear cadence.

customer_profile.name: Sophie Laurent
customer_profile.opening_message: The feature is gone and it breaks our workflow. What now?
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer stabilizes when agent provides a usable workaround + clear migration support path and cadence
customer_profile.personality_notes: Operational impact driving urgency more than emotion.

checkpoints.description: Clarify workflow and today’s critical path
Explain change at high level with boundaries
Escalate to product/migrations and set cadence
